# Error summary

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the Error summary at the top of a page to list validation errors and link each message to the field that needs attention.

## When to use

- Use after server-side or client-side validation fails on a page with user inputs.
- Place it near the top of main content and repeat each error beside its field.

## When not to use

- Do not use as the only indication that a field has an error.
- Do not use for system failures or service-wide status messages; use an appropriate error page or notification instead.

## Anatomy

- **Summary container (required):** A GOV.UK JavaScript module contains an alert region.
- **Title (required):** A heading identifies that the page contains a problem.
- **Error list (required):** Each concise message links to the related input, fieldset legend or other appropriate target.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `div` | `govuk-error-summary` | Summarise one or more validation errors on the current page. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Initialise the govuk-error-summary module so it can move focus to the summary when appropriate after validation.
- Each link must target the relevant form control; for grouped controls, target the first control unless research supports a better focus target.
- Keep server-side validation authoritative even when adding client-side validation.

## Accessibility contract

- Put the summary inside main content and keep it visible in the document without JavaScript.
- Use matching text in the summary and the inline error so users can connect them.
- Do not rely on red colour or focus movement alone to announce errors.

## Content rules

- Use a standard title such as “There is a problem”.
- Write messages that explain what happened and how to fix it, without blaming the user.
- Do not include the word “Error” before every list item.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.error`
- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.color.link`
- `govuk.color.focus`

## HTML examples

### Validation summary

```html
<div class="govuk-error-summary" data-module="govuk-error-summary">
  <div role="alert">
    <h2 class="govuk-error-summary__title">There is a problem</h2>
    <div class="govuk-error-summary__body">
      <ul class="govuk-list govuk-error-summary__list">
        <li><a href="#email">Enter an email address</a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
